name: Widows And Orphans
overview: Scripture clearly commands believers to protect and care for widows and orphans, emphasizing God's special concern for these vulnerable groups. The Lord is described as a father to the fatherless and a judge for widows, calling His people to defend the poor and afflicted by administering just judgment and relief. Afflicting or perverting justice against widows and orphans is condemned, highlighting the responsibility of God's people to uphold righteousness by helping those who have no one else to support them.
